name: phase0_artifact_demo
description: Demonstrates the pre-2026 confound on demand, as a methods figure.
Both runs use IDENTICAL selectors in both conditions, so the true effect
is exactly zero by construction. The only difference between them is
block ordering. The sequential run reproduces the old design: each
condition as one contiguous phase, so die temperature -- and with it
static leakage power -- rises in lockstep with the condition label.
Any difference the sequential run reports is therefore 100% artifact.
This is the mechanism that produced the 15 W 'effect' in out-1207-2115
and, plausibly, the +0.8 W in out-1228-1527.
Start cold and skip the inter-run cooldown so the thermal ramp lands
inside the measurement rather than before it.

runs.label: sequential_aa
runs.comment: Expect a spurious, statistically significant difference. Must FAIL the interleaving gate.

runs.label: shuffled_aa
runs.comment: Same workload, same thermal ramp, interleaved. Must land at chance.
